scope: Exact BF16 LayerNorm (4096 wide, no affine) fused with the preceding gated residual and the following modulation product; caller-owned buffers and HIP stream; no allocation or synchronization
arithmetic: Reference vectorized Welford statistics (hardware reciprocal counts, FMA updates, shuffle and shared combines), v_rsq_f32 with denormal scaling, BF16 RNE at each reference rounding point
graph_contract: Fixed shapes; caller-owned buffers and stream; initialize before capture; changed inputs supported
abi: PaitonImage21NormModulate(x, branch, params, mask, hidden_out, modulated, rows, gate_offset, scale_offset, eps, hipStream_t) -> int; PaitonImage21NormModulateQuant(..., codes, scales, rows, gate_offset, scale_offset, eps, block=256, hipStream_t) -> int (int8 per 256-column block); PaitonImage21NormModulateQuantRow(..., codes, scales, rows, gate_offset, scale_offset, eps, format 0|8, hipStream_t) -> int (fp8 e4m3fn per row, 8 = power-of-two scales)
